CRAWLER-CRAWLER_CHARACTER.title: The Crawler
CRAWLER-CRAWLER_CHARACTER.description: A blood-bound cardfighter who builds power by chaining ascending energy costs.
CRAWLER-CRAWLER_CHARACTER.goldMonologue: The Crawler counts the coins, then the pulse behind them.
CRAWLER-CRAWLER_CHARACTER.eventDeathPrev: The chain breaks, but the Crawler refuses to fall.
CRAWLER-CRAWLER_CHARACTER.cardsModifierD: Adds the Crawler's cards to rewards.
